title: Feedback compiler baseline is machine-local, so feedback:status fails in every other checkout
body:
The feedback compiler's accepted baseline is split across a tracked marker and a gitignored bundle. AI_LOOP_STATE.md names accepted compile 20260822T154750Z, but its manifest and hotspots live only in ignored ai-runs/ on the machine that produced it, so npm run feedback:status exits 1 in every other checkout and charter step 6 is a no-op wherever autonomous runs actually happen (all four #367 cycles skipped it). The documented recovery (feedback:rebootstrap inside a sealed cycle) re-baselines every checkout and leaves the original machine failing instead.

Decide where the accepted baseline lives (tracked, published alongside the corpus, or content-addressed and fetchable) so status is reproducible from any clone. The error message was improved in the 2026-09-22 sweep; the design gap remains.

Audit report: https://claude.ai/artifact/SD45nGH1YqftoSvkxL8Hbb (2026-09-22, main c17192f9).
